unreadCorrectionNotices.title: Read the linked CTNeoBC and NRG-BR005 errata at primary-text depth

review.rationale: Correction identities/links were found, but their bodies were not read. No scope is guessed and no new CTNeoBC or NRG numerical claim is adopted. Read the actual correction notices before independently recertifying the retained numerical catalogue passages; this is separate from the scoped guide definitions and qualitative biopsy limit.

sourceDepthLimits: Only selected teaching clauses are assessed. Full-field hashes do not recertify retained WHO, NICE, other trials, jurisdictions, prevalence estimates, monitoring advice or catalogue claims elsewhere in the selected owners.
